Dharagiri Waterfall: Ghatshila’s Ultimate Weekend Escape! | Vlog EP 25
Looking for a peaceful yet thrilling weekend getaway? Discover Dharagiri Waterfall, one of Jharkhand’s best-kept secrets! Hidden amidst lush green forests, this offbeat travel destination offers an unforgettable trekking adventure and mesmerizing waterfall views.
In This Vlog, You’ll Experience:
A scenic trek to Dharagiri Waterfall
Breathtaking views of the falls & natural beauty
Tips for visiting & best time to explore
Location: Dharagiri Waterfall, near Ghatshila, Jharkhand
Part of my Ghatshila Travel Vlog Series
